The '''Special Advisor to the Minister of War''' was a title held within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] with the post being in operation by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. These individuals were tasked on special assignments and used their expertise to aid the [[Minister of War (Sith Empire)|Minister of War]].

In the Cold War, [[Khun Tazith]] held this office and was stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] where he conducted a special project to sap the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Military/Legends|military forces]] on the planet by making them believe that the elite [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] unit known as the [[Bane Brigade]] were still alive.
